verdict.rationale: Sill is a local Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app with no account and no server, so it has no production data and no separate test environment to offer; a sandbox-environment story is a category error for this kind of product. The `--synthetic` flag, which streams a test pattern from a developer command-line build of the host, is a developer diagnostic. It is not a user-facing sandbox, so it does not make the axis apply.
